spots.text: OPERATOR'S LOG. Day unknown. Sorted by colour, then by weight, then by the first letter of the last word. Tomorrow, by how sad they are. It is all the same order in the end.

secrets.name: The Control Booth
secrets.text: Up the ladder, round the top of the column, a booth where someone sat and ran the engine. The levers still move. None of them is connected to anything.

meta.label: The Sorting Engine
meta.blurb: The books go round on belts, are turned on turntables, are lifted by brass arms and put down again a little further on. Nothing is ever finished being sorted.
